name: saproling burst
mana cost: {4}{G}
types: enchantment
triggered: fading 7
activated[1]: remove a fade counter from CARDNAME: create a green saproling creature token. it has "this token's power and toughness are each equal to the number of fade counters on CARDNAME."
triggered: when CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, destroy all tokens created with CARDNAME. they can't be regenerated.
